example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তিনমাথা লোক, তার অভিজ্ঞতা থেকে অনেক কিছু শেখা যায়।
গ্রামের তিনমাথা বুড়োর কথা কেউ অগ্রাহ্য করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is an extremely old man, and much can be learned from his experience.
No one ignores the words of the village's very aged elder.
history: Derived from the Bengali proverb 'তিনমাথা যেখানে বুদ্ধি নেবে সেখানে', which highlights a place of such profound wisdom that even an extremely old person would seek advice there, emphasizing respect for the elderly.
note: The idiom metaphorically exaggerates age to convey deep experience and wisdom in Bengali culture.
